text: You did your fucking five-day challenge, right?
style: Cheeky and mocking, quick, like a best friend about to roast you.

text: Five days live, bro. Pitched the offer last night. Banger.
style: Proud but exhausted, a hoarse voice after five days of lives, a casual American guy bragging to his buddy at midnight.

text: Then why are you eating cold pizza at midnight?
style: A dry, mocking roast, slow and smug, savoring 'cold pizza'.

text: Day six, man. My DMs exploded. Still open? Can I pay in two parts?
style: Stressed and overwhelmed, talking fast, reading his DMs out loud in a tired, whiny voice.
Flat and deadpan, a trap question.
Sheepish and small, a little embarrassed, short.

text: Out of hundreds. They showed up five days straight, now they're on read.
style: Suddenly dead serious, low and slow, letting it sink in.

text: Oh shit. I'm fried. Next month, no challenge.
style: Panic first, then deflated and done, venting to a friend.

text: The challenge worked, look at that inbox. What's outdated is answering every DM by hand.
style: Firm and confident, a friend shaking him awake, hitting 'by hand' hard.

text: So who answers them? You? You're a speech bubble.
style: Mocking and laughing at his buddy, roasting him.

text: Rude. Plug me into ManyChat. I learn your offer from your sales page and answer in your voice.
style: Offended for half a second on 'Rude', then smooth and confident, a sly little offer.

text: And the ones just asking the price?
style: Skeptical, raising an eyebrow, a bit tired.

text: One question at a time. Serious ones get your calendar, the rest get a real answer.
style: Calm and confident, a hint of smugness, listing it easily.

text: Okay, how do I get you?
style: Hesitant and a bit sheepish, a small pause after okay.

text: Turn off the ring light first, it's been on since Monday.
style: Mocking, laughing at him, slow and smug.

text: Comment SETTY and I'll send you everything to build your AI setter for free.
style: Smooth and smug, then warm and generous on the offer, like handing over a gift.
